name: American Auto Parts Superstore
old_description: Find Genuine Automotive Parts you require for your new, or not-so-new vehicles. Whether you’re improving your new vehicle's accessories, or just need a spark plug, you’ll find all your Parts & Accessories right here on AmericanAutoPartsSuperstore.com.
about:
American Auto Parts Superstore operates from Los Lunas, New Mexico, where it maintains a physical address at 357 Emilio Lopez Road NW. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The business functions as an online retailer of genuine automotive parts and accessories, offering original equipment manufacturer (OEM) components alongside interior and exterior accessories. Its e-commerce platform allows customers to search by part number, keyword, or vehicle identification number (VIN), and the site is powered by RevolutionParts software. The company does not manufacture products; it sources and resells parts for a wide range of vehicle makes and models.

The primary customer base consists of individual vehicle owners and automotive enthusiasts seeking replacement parts or upgrades for new and older vehicles. The company serves the automotive aftermarket retail sector, shipping orders directly to consumers across the United States.

The company states that its commitment to customer service and satisfaction drives an effort to keep parts and accessories as affordable as possible. This pricing focus, combined with a searchable catalog and direct-to-consumer shipping, forms the basis of its market positioning.
built_on: Affordable pricing on genuine OEM parts and accessories
Searchable catalog with VIN, part number, and keyword lookup
Direct-to-consumer shipping from Los Lunas, New Mexico
Customer service focus with stated satisfaction commitment
